findingDetails.title: A completion criterion's command no longer produces its stated output
findingDetails.claim: goal.md:91 requires `git status --porcelain .skilled` to print nothing; it prints two unrelated untracked paths, so the stated proof no longer reproduces.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked both untracked paths against the private-skill patterns and the ignore rules; neither is a private skill and neither is ignored.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The command was a convenient proxy for 'nothing private is staged' at authoring time and later unrelated work made the proxy fail.

findingDetails.title: The symlink half of the same criterion is unverifiable outside the operator checkout
findingDetails.claim: goal.md:91 asserts the two local-* symlinks exist, but no local-* entry exists in this worktree and the checkout scope is stated only in spec.md's handoff block.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the packet for a checkout-independent record of the two links; the durable record is the external commit ids and the operator approvals file.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The criterion is intentionally environment-scoped and the scope is documented one document away.

results.notes: Hub composition and ignore rules match; goal criteria 3 wording does not.
